name: HIV Testing Locations
description: This dataset lists locations offering HIV testing, with 599 sampled rows and 18 columns. Each row represents a testing site and includes the agency name, address, borough, ZIP code, and phone number, along with a website where available. Weekly operating hours are recorded in separate columns for each day, Monday through Sunday, though these fields are missing for roughly 60 percent of rows. The data also notes ages served, special populations served, payment and cost information, and whether free self-tests are offered. Borough coverage is concentrated in Manhattan, the Bronx, and Brooklyn, with smaller shares in Queens and Staten Island. Missing values are common in several fields, particularly hours, website, ages served, and special populations. The dataset could be used to build a searchable directory of HIV testing sites, map service availability by borough or ZIP code, compare hours and free-testing options across providers, or identify gaps in coverage for public health outreach and referral.
